title: 第23章 废苏瑶武魂公孙冶的怒火第24章 瞬杀慕容光紫色小猫爪
content_zh:
第23章废苏瑶武魂，公孙冶的怒火
“够了！”
苏墨直接冲上战台，灵海九重境的威势爆发而出。
“当我不存在吗？”
华阳身形飞掠而起，如一只雄鹰，瞬间拦住苏墨。
“滚开！”
苏墨与华阳大打出手，灵剑宗与武极宗的长老们蠢蠢欲动，眼看要爆发一场大战。
“林尘，本座让你放开她！”
公孙冶身形闪烁，不顾身份，直接杀上战台！
林尘眼神很冷，收回弑天虎武魂本源之后，苏瑶的妖狐武魂变得很虚弱，跌落到五星层次。
“林尘，到此为止吧！
我背后有人！
再敢动我，你会死得很惨！”
苏瑶脸色狰狞。
虽然她的妖狐武魂被打回原形，但，只要武魂还在，就有重新崛起的机会。
“我说过，要你双倍偿还！”
林尘眼中寒芒一闪，催动玲珑塔，刹那间，玲珑塔爆发出一股恐怖的吞噬之力。
玲珑塔连武圣意志都能吞噬，区区妖狐武魂，当然也能吞噬！
此塔虽然是玲珑女帝所有，但林尘也是能够使用的。
苏瑶突然发出惨叫声，妖狐武魂瞬间崩溃！

武魂本源之力，消散一空！
她的武魂，被废了！
一切发生得太突然，毫无征兆。
甚至没有人看到林尘如何出手。
玲珑塔挂在林尘的身上，很隐秘。
玲珑塔吞噬武魂的时候，在场之人也无法看穿。
“我……我的武魂，这不可能！”
苏瑶脸色瞬间变得惨白，毫无血色，感觉前方一片黑暗，失去了未来！
绝望！
彻底绝望！
武魂被夺，林尘经历过的，要让苏瑶也经历一遍！
苏瑶不择手段，一心只想往上爬，如今失去了武魂，简直比杀了她还要难受。
没有武魂，意味着没有未来！
她与慕容秀的婚约，也将会成为泡影。
没有六尾妖狐武魂，对慕容秀而言，苏瑶没有任何利用价值。
一切都在电光石火之间发生，公孙冶赶到战台上的时候，林尘已经废了苏瑶！
此刻，公孙冶怒火中烧，杀心大起，直接一拳朝着林尘的面门轰杀过来，携带恐怖的灵力！
content_en:
Chapter 23 Destroying Su Yao’s martial spirit, Gongsun Ye’s anger
"Enough!"
Su Mo rushed directly to the fighting platform, and the power of the ninth level of Linghai burst out.
"Think I don't exist?"
Hua Yang flew up like an eagle and stopped Su Mo instantly.
"Get away!"
Su Mo and Hua Yang fought hard, and the elders of Lingjian Sect and Wuji Sect were ready to make a move, and a war was about to break out.
"Lin Chen, I ask you to let her go!"
Gongsun Ye's figure flashed, and he went directly to the battlefield regardless of his identity!
Lin Chen's eyes were cold. After taking back the origin of the Sky-Slaying Tiger Spirit, Su Yao's Demon Fox Spirit became very weak and fell to the five-star level.
"Lin Chen, let's stop here!
There is someone behind me!
If you dare to touch me again, you will die miserably! "
Su Yao's face is ferocious.
Although her demon fox spirit was knocked back to its original form, as long as the spirit is still there, there is a chance to rise again.
"I said, I want you to pay back double!"
A cold light flashed in Lin Chen's eyes, and he activated the Linglong Tower. In an instant, the Linglong Tower erupted with a terrifying devouring power.
Linglong Tower can swallow even the will of a martial saint, and of course it can also swallow the martial soul of a mere demon fox!
Although this tower is owned by Empress Linglong, Lin Chen can still use it.
Su Yao suddenly screamed, and the demon fox spirit collapsed instantly!
The original power of the martial spirit dissipated!
Her martial spirit was destroyed!
Everything happened so suddenly and without warning.
No one even saw how Lin Chen took action.
The Linglong Tower hung on Lin Chen's body, very secretive.
When Linglong Tower devoured martial souls, no one present could see through it.
"I...my martial spirit, this is impossible!"
Su Yao's face instantly turned pale and bloodless. She felt that there was darkness ahead and she had lost her future!
despair!
Completely desperate!
Having his martial soul taken away, what Lin Chen has experienced must be experienced by Su Yao too!
Su Yao was unscrupulous and just wanted to climb up. Now that she has lost her martial soul, it is even more uncomfortable than killing her.
No martial spirit means no future!
Her engagement with Murong Xiu will also come to nothing.
Without the six-tailed demon fox spirit, Su Yao has no use value to Murong Xiu.
Everything happened in a flash. When Gongsun Ye rushed to the battlefield, Lin Chen had already defeated Su Yao!
At this moment, Gongsun Ye was furious and murderous. He punched Lin Chen directly in the face, carrying terrifying spiritual power!
